Name: Helpcard
Rules: Here is any special rules that apply to this terrain card (Normally ojectives and scoring).\\This card gives 1 point to the defenders, 2 to the attackers, and has 4 tokens

Name: Power Reactors
Rules: \emph{Power reactors}:\\Each power reactor has 2 hitpoints. Attackers score if 3 or more are destroyed, else defenders score.

Name: Shiny Thing
Rules: \emph{Shiny thing}:\\The shiny thing token is created on the marked tile. It can be held by either team. Whichever team hold it at the end scores.

Name: Triangle
Rules: \emph{Triangle}:\\If only one team has a frame on the triangle, they score.

Name: Fugitive
Rules: \emph{Extraction}:\\ Put a fugitive token anywhere in the enemy back row after deployment. The fugitive token can be held by allies. Defenders score if it reaches the objective point, else attackers score.

Name: Holo Spires
Rules: \emph{Holo-spires}:\\If there are any attacking frames on any of the holo spires at the end, attackers score, else defenders score.

Name: Church
Rules: \emph{Church}:\\ If only one team has a frame within 2 of the church, they score.

Name: The Tower
Rules: \emph{The Tower}:\\The tower has 4 hitpoints, and takes -1 damage from any attack. If it is destroyed attackers score, else defenders score.

Name: The Egg
Rules: \emph{The Egg}:\\The first frame to end two consecutive turns standing on the Egg scores it.

Name: Railway
Rules: \emph{Rail lines}:\\Any frame that ends a turn on the rails takes \smallenergy low

Name: Riverside
Rules: \emph{Gangs}:\\After deployment your opponent creates 3 gang tokens outside their back row of cards. These are init 1 1hp tokens with 1mv. Defender scores if all gangs are defeated, else attackers score

Name: Solar Farm
Rules: \emph{Solar Farm}:\\For each frame that ends a turn on the farm, that team gets 1 charge. The team with the most charge scores.

Name: Lake Crosses
Rules: \emph{The Lake Ritual}:\\The first team to end a turn with a frame on both platforms recieves the relic token, held by one of those frames. Team at the end of the game holding that token scores.

Name: Car Park
Rules: \emph{Protect the Refugees}:\\At the start of the game create 3 refugee tokens in your opponents half of the map. These are init 1 1hp and 1 mv. Attackers score if they kill all the refugees, else defenders score.

Name: Dome Campus
Rules: \emph{Stop the bomb}:\\After deployment the attacker chooses one frame to be the bomb carrier. If this frame ends a turn on the site, attackers score, else defenders score.
